nodes.name: Electrodeposition of RMNCL
nodes.procedure: First, 10 mmol Co(NO3)2·6H2O, 10 mmol Ni(CH3COO)2·4H2O, 1.8 mmol RuCl3, and 1.2 mmol MnCl2·4H2O were dissolved in 60 mL of deionized water. The solution was mixed using a magnetic stirrer and ultrasonication to homogenize it. The homogenized solution was then transferred into an electrolytic cell. Electrodeposition was carried out utilizing a standard three-electrode system. A carbon cloth (2x2 cm) was soaked under the liquid as the working electrode. The reference electrode used was the saturated calomel electrode (SCE), while the counter electrode was a carbon rod. The samples were subjected to cyclic voltammetry, with a potential scan of 0 to -1.8 V vs. SCE, scanning rate of 50 mVs^-1, and 40 scanning cycles. The resulting samples were washed with anhydrous ethanol and deionized water, then dried in a vacuum drying oven.

properties.interpretation: Positive values of -COHP (above 0 on the y-axis) indicate bonding interactions, while negative values (below 0 on the y-axis) indicate anti-bonding interactions. The vertical line at 0 eV on the x-axis typically represents the Fermi level, separating occupied from unoccupied states.
